meta.note: Years are astronomical (1 BC = 0). lo/hi bound each date; every answer holds at the worst case inside those bounds (margin = smallest other-pair gap minus largest answer-pair gap, in years). Built by tools/build_trios.py from tools/events.py and events2.py; every source page was fetched on 2026-11-25 and checked to contain the stated date. Rules enforced: 100+ trios, no event in more than 4 trios, every region and era covered.
